sloka: परस्परस्य सदृशौ प्रमाण इन्गित चेष्टितैः ।काक पक्ष धरौ वीरौ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥१-५०-२१॥
transliteration: parasparasya sadṛśau pramāṇa ingita ceṣṭitaiḥ ।kāka pakṣa dharau vīrau śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1-50-21॥

translations.english: Great ascetic, these two young men with hair falling on their temples like the wings of a crow, each of them resemble the other in personality, expressions and gestures. Wielding excellent weapons they adorn this land like the Moon and the Sun deck the sky. Whose sons are they? I wish truly to hear about these heroes".
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर वह ( अहल्या ) इन्द्र से बोली, हे. इन्द्र ! मेरा मनोरथ पूरा हो गया, अ; हे देवताओं में श्रेष्ठ इन्द्र ! यहाँ से अब तुम शीघ्र चले ,जाओ
